title: Bug: GCU test_update_valid_index that was re-ebnabled recently  fails for multi-asic
author: okaravasi
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Hello,

Test `generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py::test_update_valid_index` was skipped and enabled recently via PR.
However multi-asic support was not added in this test, and this Issue is to track this failure.

More specifically, there are `sonic-db-cli `commands that need to be updated and take as argument the namespace in case platform is multi-asic.





### Steps to Reproduce

Ran test in a luti-asic platform

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Patch operation fails as the interface name is not retrieved successfully in mutli-asic platform.
Patch shoudl succeed.
